upload_diff_to_codereview: upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to the codereview.appspot.com code review server
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a diff against a specific revision using the --rev option with git, hg, or svn
upload_base_files: upload base files for side-by-side diff comparison using the --download_base flag
create_code_review_issue: create a new code review issue with description, reviewers, and CC email addresses
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate with Google ClientLogin to obtain auth cookies for uploading patches
